description: This file contains unit tests for the RemoveKeySession IPC functionality in the Rialto media key handling system. It defines a test fixture class and multiple test cases to verify success, failure, and reconnection scenarios for removing a key session via IPC.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcRemoveKeySessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysIpcTestBase, used to test the removeKeySession IPC functionality with setup and teardown methods, and helper functions to simulate responses.

methods.name: setRemoveKeySessionResponseSuccess
methods.description: Sets a successful RemoveKeySessionResponse with error status OK.

methods.name: setRemoveKeySessionResponseFailed
methods.description: Sets a RemoveKeySessionResponse with a failure error status.
